title: Independent short-gap audit reproduces paragraph conditioning and survives a line-word null
statement: On 615 paired public practice paragraph lines, independently built runs and gap moments reproduce all published observed statistics. For EVA o, the within-run mean centered gap coefficient over occurrence lags1–5 exceeds intact-word paragraph shuffles at p=0.009–0.012 in ZL and0.003–0.007 in Takahashi across three fixed999-draw seeds. It also exceeds a separately declared whole-word shuffle within each original line (p=0.032–0.045 ZL,0.004–0.007 Takahashi). All27 original synthetic calibration summaries reproduce after following the published rate-specific seed wrapper. The o result is an ordering-dependent public-text statistic relative to these nulls, not a language or hidden-page finding. The separate r lag20 result loses pair support and does not justify a broad absence claim.
check: Reproduce the original observation, all27 synthetic cases and the independent paragraph/line word-null audit with the embedded runner at the recorded runtime base. Compare all raw output hashes, published summary fields, pair counts and three seed results rather than selecting one. A conditional gap/word-permutation primitive needs trusted DSL integration and a frozen claim before any hidden-page fact; this experiment submits no such fact. Keep r lag20 separate and specify power/support before making a negative claim.

plan.scope: Public practice pages only. Independently audit the existing measurement and reproduce the complete published synthetic calibration before suggesting a hidden-page fact.
plan.selection: Use the intersection of nonempty paragraph-line locus IDs whose words contain only acdefghiklmnopqrsty in both ZL and Takahashi practice evaluation pages. Keep original page/run order; paragraph flags and omitted paragraph lines break runs. Ignore non-paragraph lines.
plan.metric: For each run, count raw EVA positions in the space-joined word sequence, derive consecutive-hit differences, and center by the mean of all gaps in that run. At lag h retain a run only if number of gaps > h+1. Pool crossproducts and squared centered endpoints across runs; divide pooled crossproduct by sqrt(pooled squared endpoints). Require at least 25 eligible pairs for a lag. Average lags1..5 defined in the observed and all null draws.
plan.primary: EVA o, within original paragraph runs, mean lags1..5, one-sided exceedance against intact-word shuffling separately within each run, no change to run order.
plan.replication: Reproduce bench.py --observe at99 permutations and all27 scenarios using the original published README and rate_sensitivity.py: base rate0.160 seed19026011, rate0.124 seed19046011, rate0.036 seed19056011, with each scenario-index SeedSequence;64 books and99 permutations. All bands, scoring and nulls unchanged.
plan.independent_audit: Build matched runs and compute centered gap moments independently with standard-library explicit pairs and fsum. Compare metrics and pair counts to the NumPy benchmark and merged vs.gaps implementation; use identical shuffled orders to audit tail ranks.
plan.monte_carlo_sensitivity: For the primary o measurement, run 999 intact-word permutations with each of seeds408,19026011,28027 in both editions; report observed values, null means, excesses, tail counts and plus-one p-values. These are robustness RNG repeats on the same observed text, not independent studies. Do not choose a seed or threshold based on its result.
plan.r_diagnostic: Keep r lag20 separate. Reproduce published page-versus-paragraph pair counts and descriptive p-values at99 permutations. Do not interpret sparse within-paragraph support as proof of no recurrence. No new r significance claim.
plan.synthetic_interpretation: Report all rate-shift false rejections and explicit lag20-copy power cases. Treat the fixed 11..40 average and point lag20 as different estimands. Do not replace missing power by a broad negative conclusion.
plan.negative_word_order_controls: Use 32 primary-layout null books per edition made by independent intact-word run shuffling, seed991307 with book-index seed; assess each with99 new intact-word permutations from seed55201+book_index. Report empirical rejection counts at<=0.05, with paired editions and reused layouts noted. This is an additional audit of the actual word-null measurement, distinct from hit-slot synthetic calibration.
plan.stop_rule: No symbol, band, score, selected lines, permutation count or seed selection based on outcomes. A mismatch is reported and traced, not hidden by altered parameters. No manuscript hidden pages or seed are accessed.
plan.submission: One step experiment with data, full reproduction code, input/output hashes and limitations. No hidden-page fact is submitted in this audit because the corresponding conditional gap/word-null primitive is not yet in the fact DSL.
plan.secondary_line_null: Additionally shuffle intact words separately within each original retained line, preserving line lengths, line word stocks and line/run order. Use the same999 permutation counts and seeds408,19026011,28027 for EVA o. Treat this as a separately declared descriptive sensitivity control; do not replace the primary paragraph-word null after outcomes.

scripts.run_calibration.py:
"""Reproduce every published conditional-hit calibration case, three workers."""
import hashlib
import argparse
import json
import math
import multiprocessing
from concurrent.futures import ProcessPoolExecutor, as_completed
from functools import lru_cache
from pathlib import Path
from statistics import median

import bench
from vs import corpus

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
CASES = [(rate, index) for rate in (.160, .124, .036) for index in range(9)]
RATE_KEYS = {.160: 'rate_0_160_primary', .124: 'rate_0_124_sensitivity', .036: 'rate_0_036_sensitivity'}


@lru_cache(maxsize=1)
def layout():
    pages = {e: corpus.split_pages('practice', e)[1] for e in ('zl', 'it')}
    retained = bench.line_ids(pages['zl']) & bench.line_ids(pages['it'])
    return bench.template(bench.layout(pages['zl'], retained))


def wilson(k, n):
    z = 1.959963984540054
    p = k/n
    denominator = 1+z*z/n
    midpoint = (p+z*z/(2*n))/denominator
    radius = z*math.sqrt(p*(1-p)/n+z*z/(4*n*n))/denominator
    return [round(midpoint-radius, 4), round(midpoint+radius, 4)]


def summarize(raw):
    cases = raw['replicates']
    keys = sorted({key for row in cases for key in row['scores']})
    result = {'regime': list(raw['regime']), 'books': len(cases), 'eligible_character_slots': raw['total_slots'],
              'median_hit_rate': round(median(row['hit_count']/raw['total_slots'] for row in cases), 5), 'tests': {}}
    for key in keys:
        rows = [row['scores'][key] for row in cases if key in row['scores']]
        k = sum(r['p'] <= .05 for r in rows)
        record = {'total_books': len(cases), 'eligible_books': len(rows), 'rejections': k,
                  'rejection_fraction': round(k/len(rows), 4), 'wilson_95': wilson(k, len(rows)),
                  'median_observed': round(median(r['observed'] for r in rows), 6),
                  'median_null_mean': round(median(r['null_mean'] for r in rows), 6),
                  'median_excess': round(median(r['observed']-r['null_mean'] for r in rows), 6),
                  'median_supported_lags': median(r['lags'] for r in rows),
                  'median_pairs_summed_over_lags': median(sum(r['pairs_by_lag'].values()) for r in rows)}
        band = key.split('/')[-1]
        important = (1,) if band == 'short_1_5' else (20,) if band == 'lag_20' else (20, 40)
        for lag in important:
            supported = [r['pairs_by_lag'][str(lag)] for r in rows if str(lag) in r['pairs_by_lag']]
            record[f'books_supporting_lag_{lag}'] = len(supported)
            record[f'median_pairs_lag_{lag}'] = median(supported) if supported else None
        result['tests'][key] = record
    return result


def run_case(case):
    rate, index = case
    bench.BASE_RATE = rate
    # Published rate_sensitivity.py uses distinct, documented seed offsets.
    bench.SEED = 19026011 + {.160: 0, .124: 20000, .036: 30000}[rate]
    raw = bench.run_scenario(index, layout(), 64, 99)
    filename = f'calibration-{rate:.3f}-{index}.json'
    payload = (json.dumps(raw, sort_keys=True)+'\n').encode()
    (ROOT/filename).write_bytes(payload)
    return {'rate': rate, 'index': index, 'raw_file': filename,
            'raw_sha256': hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest(), 'summary': summarize(raw)}


def differences(actual, expected, path=''):
    errors = []
    if isinstance(actual, dict) and isinstance(expected, dict):
        if actual.keys() != expected.keys():
            return [path+': keys '+str(actual.keys()-expected.keys())+' / '+str(expected.keys()-actual.keys())]
        for key in actual:
            errors += differences(actual[key], expected[key], path+'/'+key)
    elif isinstance(actual, list) and isinstance(expected, list):
        if len(actual) != len(expected):
            return [path+': length']
        for i, (a, b) in enumerate(zip(actual, expected)):
            errors += differences(a, b, path+'/'+str(i))
    elif isinstance(actual, (int, float)) and isinstance(expected, (int, float)):
        if not math.isclose(actual, expected, abs_tol=1e-10, rel_tol=1e-10):
            errors.append(path+': '+repr(actual)+' != '+repr(expected))
    elif actual != expected:
        errors.append(path+': '+repr(actual)+' != '+repr(expected))
    return errors


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--sensitivity-only', action='store_true')
    sensitivity_only = parser.parse_args().sensitivity_only
    assert hashlib.sha256((ROOT/'bench.py').read_bytes()).hexdigest() == '7fdadf75a4790f458be50373a69afbbd48ed6409c3729114e709b8eaa318d12a'
    expected = json.loads((ROOT/'expected-calibration.json').read_bytes())
    outputs = []
    with ProcessPoolExecutor(max_workers=3, mp_context=multiprocessing.get_context('spawn')) as executor:
        jobs = {executor.submit(run_case, case): case for case in CASES if not sensitivity_only or case[0] != .160}
        for future in as_completed(jobs):
            result = future.result()
            name = RATE_KEYS[result['rate']]
            reference = next(row for row in expected[name] if row['regime'][0] == result['summary']['regime'][0])
            result['published_differences'] = differences(result['summary'], reference)
            outputs.append(result)
            print(result['rate'], result['index'], 'published differences', len(result['published_differences']), flush=True)
    outputs.sort(key=lambda r: (r['rate'], r['index']))
    final = {'cases': outputs, 'all_27_summary_objects_match': len(outputs) == 27 and all(not x['published_differences'] for x in outputs),
             'total_simulated_books': len(outputs)*64, 'permutations_per_test': 99}
    output_name = 'calibration-sensitivity-audit.json' if sensitivity_only else 'calibration-audit.json'
    (ROOT/output_name).write_bytes((json.dumps(final, indent=2)+'\n').encode())
    print('ALL MATCH', final['all_27_summary_objects_match'], flush=True)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

"""Recheck saved synthetic data after JSON tuple/list metadata normalization.

No simulation or measurement is rerun or changed by this script.
"""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import run_calibration as driver

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
expected = json.loads((ROOT/'expected-calibration.json').read_bytes())
outputs = []
for rate, index in driver.CASES:
    name = f'calibration-{rate:.3f}-{index}.json'
    raw = (ROOT/name).read_bytes()
    summary = driver.summarize(json.loads(raw))
    reference = next(r for r in expected[driver.RATE_KEYS[rate]] if r['regime'][0] == summary['regime'][0])
    errors = driver.differences(summary, reference)
    outputs.append({'rate': rate, 'index': index, 'raw_file': name,
                    'raw_sha256': hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(), 'summary': summary,
                    'published_differences': errors})
outputs.sort(key=lambda r: (r['rate'], r['index']))
target = ROOT/'calibration-audit.json'
if target.exists():
    (ROOT/'calibration-audit-original-validator.json').write_bytes(target.read_bytes())
data = {'cases': outputs, 'all_27_summary_objects_match': all(not x['published_differences'] for x in outputs),
        'total_simulated_books': 27*64, 'permutations_per_test': 99}
target.write_bytes((json.dumps(data, indent=2)+'\n').encode())
print('Fully matching saved synthetic summaries:', sum(not r['published_differences'] for r in outputs), 'of 27')

scripts.summarize.py:
import argparse
from collections import defaultdict
from math import sqrt
from pathlib import Path
import json
from statistics import median

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent


def wilson(successes, total):
    z = 1.959963984540054
    p = successes / total
    denominator = 1 + z*z/total
    center = (p + z*z/(2*total)) / denominator
    radius = z * sqrt(p*(1-p)/total + z*z/(4*total*total)) / denominator
    return [round(max(0, center - radius), 4), round(min(1, center + radius), 4)]


def summary(book):
    eligible = defaultdict(list)
    for replicate in book['replicates']:
        for test, record in replicate['scores'].items():
            eligible[test].append(record)
    result = {}
    for test, records in sorted(eligible.items()):
        rejects = sum(r['p'] <= .05 for r in records)
        result[test] = {
            'rejections': rejects,
            'eligible_books': len(records),
            'total_books': len(book['replicates']),
            'rejection_fraction': round(rejects/len(records), 4),
            'wilson_95': wilson(rejects, len(records)),
            'median_observed': round(median(r['observed'] for r in records), 6),
            'median_null_mean': round(median(r['null_mean'] for r in records), 6),
            'median_excess': round(median(r['observed'] - r['null_mean'] for r in records), 6),
            'median_supported_lags': median(r['lags'] for r in records),
            'median_pairs_summed_over_lags': median(sum(r['pairs_by_lag'].values()) for r in records),
        }
        for lag in ('1', '20', '40'):
            available = [r['pairs_by_lag'][lag] for r in records if lag in r['pairs_by_lag']]
            if available:
                result[test]['books_supporting_lag_' + lag] = len(available)
                result[test]['median_pairs_lag_' + lag] = median(available)
    return {'regime':book['regime'], 'eligible_character_slots':book['total_slots'],
            'books':len(book['replicates']), 'median_hit_rate':round(median(r['hit_count']/book['total_slots'] for r in book['replicates']),5),
            'tests':result}


if __name__ == '__main__':
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("directory", type=Path, default=ROOT, nargs="?")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    files = [args.directory / f'scenario-{i}.json' for i in range(9)]
    books = [summary(json.loads(file.read_text())) for file in files]
    print(json.dumps(books, indent=2, sort_keys=True))

"""Run the submitted public audit: python reproduce_gap.py STEP_JSON SCRATCH.

Use --verify-existing to check existing outputs without repeating simulations.
"""
import argparse
import base64
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import zlib

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument('submission')
parser.add_argument('scratch')
parser.add_argument('--verify-existing', action='store_true')
args = parser.parse_args()
data = json.loads(Path(args.submission).read_bytes())
scratch = Path(args.scratch).resolve()
scratch.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
for record in data['input_files']:
    payload = Path(record['file']).read_bytes()
    if record.get('hash_mode') == 'lf_normalized':
        payload = payload.replace(b'\r\n', b'\n')
    assert hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest() == record['sha256'], record['file']
import numpy
assert numpy.__version__ == data['plan']['environment']['numpy'], numpy.__version__
for name, fixture in data['reproduction']['fixtures'].items():
    payload = zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(fixture['data']))
    assert hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest() == fixture['sha256'], name
    (scratch/name).write_bytes(payload)
(scratch/'plan.json').write_bytes(data['reproduction']['plan_json_bytes'].encode())
for name, script in data['reproduction']['scripts'].items():
    (scratch/name).write_bytes(script.encode())
def verify(name):
    assert hashlib.sha256((scratch/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == data['output_digests'][name], name
for name in ('plan.json', 'bench.py', 'rate_sensitivity.py', 'audit_gaps.py', 'run_calibration.py'):
    verify(name)
env = dict(os.environ)
env.update(PYTHONPATH=str(Path.cwd())+os.pathsep+env.get('PYTHONPATH', ''),
           OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS='1', OMP_NUM_THREADS='1')
if not args.verify_existing:
    for name in ('audit_gaps.py', 'run_calibration.py'):
        subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-X', 'utf8', str(scratch/name)], env=env,
                       stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, check=True)
for name in ('published-observation.json', 'audit.json', 'calibration-audit.json'):
    verify(name)
    print(name, 'exact digest matched', flush=True)
calibration = json.loads((scratch/'calibration-audit.json').read_bytes())
assert calibration['all_27_summary_objects_match']
for case in calibration['cases']:
    assert hashlib.sha256((scratch/case['raw_file']).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == case['raw_sha256']
print('All 27 raw synthetic outputs verified.', flush=True)

reproduction.instructions: At runtime_base with verified pinned raw inputs, extract reproduce_gap.py and run python reproduce_gap.py /path/to/step.json /path/to/scratch from the repository root. Python3.12 and NumPy2.3.5 are required; the benchmark source used that version. The runner restores hash-checked zlib/base64 JSON fixtures and frozen code, performs the public audit and all27 corrected-source calibration cases, and verifies raw hashes. --verify-existing validates already-computed outputs without extra simulations. All outputs use explicit UTF-8 bytes/LF. Full Monte Carlo draws and synthetic books are recreated in the hashed scratch outputs; compact tables are retained here. Original protocol/driver versions are fixtures for tracing the two disclosed amendments.

findings: Both independent and merged implementations retain615 common paragraph-line loci on31 public pages, yielding128 ZL and131 Takahashi runs. Omitted paragraph lines, paragraph flags and page boundaries split runs; non-paragraph labels are ignored. All original observed scalar values, null means, probabilities and pair-count tables reproduce at99 permutations.

The measured quantity is a pooled cosine-like coefficient of run-mean-centered occurrence gaps: sum of lagged products divided by the endpoint norms. It is not a new Pearson fit to each truncated lag vector. Independent explicit-pair fsum calculations agree with the NumPy benchmark within1.1102230246251565e-16, and the merged vs.gaps default399-draw seed408 result agrees with the independent calculation.

For o the observed mean over lags1–5 is -0.014750965122495643 in ZL and -0.011830306507526851 in Takahashi. These raw coefficients are negative; the reported effect is their excess over more-negative intact-word nulls, not positive raw autocorrelation.

With intact-word shuffling inside each original run and999 permutations at seeds408,19026011,28027, ZL p-values are0.009,0.012,0.012 and Takahashi p-values0.004,0.003,0.007. No seed was selected or threshold retuned. The paired editions read the same pages and these seed repetitions reuse the same observation.

The independently declared line-word null preserves each retained line's complete words, multiplicities and total character length, and preserves line/run/page order. Its corresponding p-values are0.032,0.034,0.045 in ZL and0.004,0.005,0.007 in Takahashi. Thus the tested effect is not removed simply by preserving the line-specific word stock, although ZL is closer to the conventional threshold.

On32 independently shuffled word-null books per edition, the same99-draw primary procedure rejects0/32 in ZL and2/32 in Takahashi at p<=0.05. This small finite calibration is not a population error guarantee; the editions and layouts are paired.

All27 published synthetic scenarios,64 books each (1728 books), match every reported numerical summary with the documented original source recipe. The nine base-rate0.160 scenarios use seed19026011. limitations: The effect is descriptive on the public practice sample. It has not been scored on hidden pages and does not establish language, meaning, decipherment or a physical glyph inventory.
ZL and Takahashi are paired transcriptions of the same pages, not two independent manuscripts. Monte Carlo seeds and null books are robustness/calibration repeats on shared layouts.

The symbol, short band and statistic were inherited from earlier public exploration. The new line-word control and RNG checks were declared before their outcomes. This is an audit and sensitivity check, not a discovery corrected over all symbols and lag bands.

Whole-word nulls preserve internal spelling and local word stocks but alter word order. A residual can be produced by mechanical ordering rules or other local constraints; it does not identify a linguistic mechanism.
Some ZL line-null estimates are near0.05, with finite Monte Carlo uncertainty. Pair counts overlap within runs and should not be treated as independent observations.

No trusted fact-DSL primitive for this conditional gap statistic/word null is currently exposed by the existing public-only command. Submitting a hidden-page fact before that integration would be invalid; this contribution is kind step.
